primary_evidence.selection_rule: distinct target/phenotype, at least 20 reported actives, at most 5000 reported compounds
primary_evidence.acquisition_gate: hash exact source archive and used members; reconcile raw, parsed, duplicate, conflict, preparation-failure, scored, and unscored counts before results

secondary_diagnostic.claim_boundary: generated property-matched decoys are vulnerable to analogue and decoy bias and do not establish performance on measured inactives

ranking.duplicate_key: RDKit canonical isomeric SMILES of the sanitized source graph without uncharging, tautomerization, or fragment removal
ranking.tie_policy: fractional membership and expected rank within exact score ties
ranking.failure_policy: unscored parents retained as one worst-ranked tie group

metrics.pr_auc_definition: non-interpolated average precision at distinct score thresholds

sensitivity.chemical_state: all bounded states on a hash-selected sentinel panel; report ranges, never best-state enrichment
sensitivity.receptor: primary holo receptor versus one predeclared alternate experimental holo receptor of the same phenotype
sensitivity.box: primary co-crystal box versus the same center with 3.0 additional angstrom on every face

amendment_policy: Any change requires a numbered amendment recorded before inspecting docking scores; unavailable inputs may stop but never silently alter the run.
